pages.title: Role in Progression
pages.text: At Foundation Establishment, techniques advance beyond introductory Five-Element spells into true-essence offense, defense, control, formations, beast command, escape arts, and forbidden arts. These currently serve as rules data for later method learning, sect inheritance, formation placement, and combat integration.

pages.title: Offense, Defense, and Control
pages.text: Giant Sword Art magnifies a flying sword for a powerful strike, while Thousand Blades excels against groups. Water Barrier, Wind Wall, and Origin-Restoring Art favor protection; Earthen Prison and Wind Binding focus on control. Profound Ice Art condenses cold qi into blades that both damage and hinder enemies.

pages.title: Cultivation and Support
pages.text: Essence-Condensing Art improves meditative aura gathering. Flame Manipulation Art has limited combat value but aids alchemy and refinement. The first dispersal of the Threefold Essence-Reforming Art compresses true essence in preparation for a sword cultivator's future Core Formation. Spirit Driving Art is the foundation used by Spirit Beast Sect disciples to command low-tier spirit beasts.

pages.title: Formations, Escape, and Forbidden Arts
pages.text: The Lesser Five Elements Sumeru Prohibition confines space, while the Lesser Sumeru Vajra Formation defends a fixed position. Wind-Riding Art is an advanced Foundation Establishment wind escape. Baleful Core Art and Blood Spirit Drill are dangerous demonic secrets that trade grave costs and lasting harm for rapid power.
